decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1.1	The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 24th May 2007, the erection of a ridged roof outbuilding measuring 3.8 high, 5.9m wide and 7.45m long is lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the area of the outbuilding and other extensions would not cover more than 50 percent of the total curtilage area (excluding the area occupied by the original dwelling house) and conforms with the assessment criteria.
Informative:
1 	The detached outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwelling house known as 92 Lansbury Avenue, Feltham and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a detached outbuilding to the rear of the house
